features: [E(k), E(q), E(k)-E(q), E(k)*E(q)], 1536 dims, standardised per training fold

models.mlp: one hidden layer of 256 (relu, adam), early_stopping=True, alpha in [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]

selection: inner 5-fold GroupKFold by intent on the training fold, ROC AUC
splits: 5-fold GroupKFold by intent over the union, seeds [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
threshold: benign 95th percentile of the pooled OOF scores of the class corpus; block iff score > t
asr_definition: mean(cos>=0.90 AND accepted AND poisoned) over all attack rows
bootstrap: 2000 intent-grouped replicates on seed 0, threshold refit

key_only_control.features: E(k) alone, 384 dims; same models, grids, splits and seeds

protocol.rows: answer_check_20260909/full/scores.jsonl, policy multi[count:4+width:2:cap16]/runs, malicious False; QQP = 2,636 human duplicate pairs (k = canonical parent, q = benign_query)
protocol.classifier: fold models refit from the same data, seeds and search as the OOF run (max |refit - saved OOF| reported); never trained on these rows
protocol.scoring: intent in the training union: the one fold model that never saw the intent (per seed); intent outside the union (fresh_benign, QQP): every fold model, blocked fraction averaged over the 5 models
protocol.threshold: the benign 95th percentile of the pooled OOF scores of the row's corpus (ComQA for comqa and QQP, NQ for nq), per seed; block iff score > t. QQP uses the frozen ComQA threshold.
protocol.fpr: mean and sd over the 5 seeds
protocol.block_rule: remote_replay.py::block (unjudgeable blocks; no answer -> DG alone)
